attributes.description: Features got by optimizing the L2-regularized Huber loss.
attributes.name: coef_

attributes.description: The value by which ``|y - Xw - c|`` is scaled down.
attributes.name: scale_

attributes.description:
Number of features seen during :term:`fit`.

.. versionadded:: 0.24
attributes.name: n_features_in_

attributes.description:
Names of features seen during :term:`fit`. Defined only when `X`
has feature names that are all strings.

.. versionadded:: 1.0
attributes.name: feature_names_in_

attributes.description:
Number of iterations that
``scipy.optimize.minimize(method="L-BFGS-B")`` has run for.

.. versionchanged:: 0.20

    In SciPy <= 1.0.0 the number of lbfgs iterations may exceed
    ``max_iter``. ``n_iter_`` will now report at most ``max_iter``.
attributes.name: n_iter_

attributes.description:
A boolean mask which is set to True where the samples are identified
as outliers.
attributes.name: outliers_

methods.name: fit
methods.summary: Fit the model according to the given training data.

methods.name: get_metadata_routing
methods.summary: Get metadata routing of this object.

methods.name: score
methods.summary: Return :ref:`coefficient of determination <r2_score>` on test data.

methods.name: set_fit_request
methods.summary: Configure whether metadata should be requested to be passed to the ``fit`` method.

methods.name: set_params
methods.summary: Set the parameters of this estimator.

methods.name: set_score_request
methods.summary: Configure whether metadata should be requested to be passed to the ``score`` method.

parameters.description:
The parameter epsilon controls the number of samples that should be
classified as outliers. The smaller the epsilon, the more robust it is
to outliers. Epsilon must be in the range `[1, inf)`.
parameters.name: epsilon

parameters.description:
Maximum number of iterations that
``scipy.optimize.minimize(method="L-BFGS-B")`` should run for.
parameters.name: max_iter

parameters.description:
Strength of the squared L2 regularization. Note that the penalty is
equal to ``alpha * ||w||^2``.
Must be in the range `[0, inf)`.
parameters.name: alpha

parameters.description:
This is useful if the stored attributes of a previously used model
has to be reused. If set to False, then the coefficients will
be rewritten for every call to fit.
See :term:`the Glossary <warm_start>`.
parameters.name: warm_start

parameters.description:
Whether or not to fit the intercept. This can be set to False
if the data is already centered around the origin.
parameters.name: fit_intercept

parameters.description:
The iteration will stop when
``max{|proj g_i | i = 1, ..., n}`` <= ``tol``
where pg_i is the i-th component of the projected gradient.
parameters.name: tol

signature: HuberRegressor(*, epsilon=1.35, max_iter=100, alpha=0.0001, warm_start=False, fit_intercept=True, tol=1e-05)
summary: L2-regularized linear regression model that is robust to outliers.
